name: skill-quality
description: Skill-authoring QA tooling: a static contract checker that runs twenty-two deterministic checks over a Claude Code skill (frontmatter, per-skill listing-entry cap, trigger-keyword preservation, line caps, broken internal refs, markdownlint, gotchas surface, evals presence, precompute opportunity, injection shell-declaration, fresh-eyes declaration conformance), a shared skill-listing budget reporter across a set of skills, and a bundled evals.json schema for validation. Runs against any repo's skills directory via the convention-resolution ladder — no baked layout.
